altText: Three invented sampled T cells carry simplified alpha/beta pairs X/B, Y/B and Z/C. The bulk beta-chain view pools B, B and C without alpha linkage. In the paired-cell view separate sampled-cell boxes link each alpha and beta chain, exposing two different alpha identities behind shared beta B. Labels are fictional identities, not sequence or cell-count results. Read abundance is not automatically cell abundance; pairing does not establish antigen specificity, function or killing.
